authority: Internal Revenue Service / United States Code Title 26

in_scope: Sole proprietor and single-member LLC business income (Schedule C)
out_of_scope: STATE AND LOCAL INCOME TAX. This is the single largest gap in the US pack. 43 states impose an individual income tax with independent rules, and several cities impose their own.
Corporate (1120), S corporation (1120-S) and partnership (1065) returns
Estate, gift and generation-skipping transfer tax
International reporting: FBAR, FATCA, Form 5471, Form 8938
Sales and use tax, which is state administered and out of scope entirely

L. 119-21, enacted July 2025), which changed the standard deduction, SALT cap, section 179 limit and bonus depreciation mid-year. Every entry must be checked against the controlling Revenue Procedure and the enacted statute by a credentialed preparer before use.
